digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess environment management
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths currently rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, enabling unintended scope writes and credential leakage to unrelated siblings
Jira Cloud has implicit `DIG` fallbacks in the write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that should fail closed when scope is absent

Child processes lack environment isolation: same-capability children should inherit ambient variables, owning children should receive only their adapter overlay, and unrelated siblings should not see other adapters' secret names
Global `os.environ` is mutated during operation execution instead of being scoped and immutable
CLI `-c` tracker/Jira/reconciler selections and static adapter material are not properly bounded across the reconciler subprocess boundary as non-secret vs. secret material
